lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Prepare project A with saved tracks and project B without tracks
Verify the picker rows contain only project names
Open the track list in A
In Switch project tap B and confirm only the radio is selected without switching
press Cancel and remain on A
tap B then Open to switch
Switch A to B to A without killing the process
Open the track list and inspect the map after each switch
Start manual sync and try switching immediately and between sequential accounts
choose the sync interruption action and verify the switch continues after the lease closes
Verify that switching is refused while a track is actively recording
value.expected: Map paths, metadata, layers and track history always come from the active project; A restores its tracks, B remains empty, the picker exposes no account/id/district text, a row tap only selects the radio, Open switches and Cancel leaves the current project, sync interruption is explicit and waits for lease release, and active recording cannot cross the project boundary.
